item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Custom block response code and body for Application Gateway WAF
item.description:
Azure WAF on Application Gateway is now generally available with support for custom block response status codes and response bodies for blocked requests. This lets you define the HTTP response returned when WAF blocks a request.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Exceptions in WAF for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door
item.description:
Azure Web Application Firewall now has an exceptions feature in public preview for Azure Application Gateway and Azure Front Door. It lets you allow specific requests that would otherwise be blocked as false positives, complementing existing exclusions.

  • Source: Azure Updates
